notes: FOS Lighting (foslighting.in) has been re-platformed to a Next.js/React storefront since the prior Home-Decor pass (previously Magento-style URLs, same slugs still work server-rendered via Next.js). Checked: (1) full header mega-nav and mobile nav (identical link set) - only product-type categories (Chandeliers, Pendants, Wall>{Picture Lights,Spot Lights,Sconces}, Bath, Ceiling>{Flush mount,Recessed,Track}, Table, Floor, Outdoor>{Bollards,Gate Lights,Pole Lights,Wall Lights,Hanging Lights}, Lamps, Festive Lights, Accessories, 1Eva) plus a single 'Clearance' link (/sale) - no Bestsellers/Popular/Top Sellers link anywhere. (2) Footer nav - only policy/info pages, no merchandising link. (3) sitemap.xml (1515 URLs) grepped case-insensitively for best|popular|trend|favorite - zero hits besides unrelated substring matches (e.g. 'clear' inside bulb names). (4) Direct URL probes for /best-sellers, /bestsellers, /best-selling, /top-sellers, /popular, /trending, /customer-favorites, /most-popular - all return HTTP 200 but are soft-404s (Next.js App Router notFound boundary, literal page content 'The lights are out on this page' / 404, same as a deliberately nonsense slug). (5) Backend product tag field 'websiteCategories' embedded in the RSC JSON on both the homepage and the /sale listing - the only distinct values observed are 'sale' and ordinary product-type slugs (e.g. 'sconces'); no 'bestseller'/'popular'/'trending' tag exists in the data model at all. (6) Site's own search (/search?q=...) for 'bestseller' returns 10 results, but the page's own h1 is literally the search term 'bestseller' (a generic text-match search-results page, not a merchandising PLP) - excluded per brief Section 3 (search-results pages are explicitly excluded even when they surface candidates). A control query with a nonsense term ('xyzqnotarealterm') also returned a non-zero result (1), confirming this is fuzzy text search noise, not evidence of a genuine Bestsellers concept. No genuine Bestsellers/Best Selling/Top Sellers/Popular/Trending/Customer Favorites PLP exists anywhere on this site under its own taxonomy.
